objective: Reduce remaining Opus55 acceptance work without weakening frozen protocols by deriving implication, identifiability, minimum discriminators, and exact load-bearing component proof slices before any new reality query.

protocol_implication_scope_algebra.role: Derive candidate EXACT or PROVEN_STRONGER scope relation from explicit normalized atoms, independently verified implication edges, and metric bounds instead of trusting hand-authored scope booleans.
protocol_implication_scope_algebra.hard_limit: Semantic normalization is outside this compiler and must remain independently content-addressed and fail-closed.

epistemic_closure_minimum_discriminator.role: On an explicit finite admissible world set, act only on unanimous conclusions; otherwise compute the exact minimum-cost authorized discriminator or return principled nonidentifiability.
epistemic_closure_minimum_discriminator.hard_limit: The kernel never generates semantic worlds and therefore cannot hide semantic-interpretation residuals.

composition_component_proof_slicer.role: Reduce composition dependency only over exact component interfaces used by the frozen claim and only from independently verified acceptance-scoped claim-bound receipts.
composition_component_proof_slicer.hard_limit: No whole-family pass inheritance and no component receipt may cover an undeclared interface by analogy.

promotion_rules: ANY SEMANTIC NORMALIZATION USED FOR SCOPE IMPLICATION MUST HAVE ITS OWN CONTENT_ADDRESSED RECEIPT
